fixture.background_foreground_window: a notepad.exe started and stopped by the harness session; during orb-idle-background of the before run another process (pid 17472) held the foreground instead, Sirio stayed inactive in both cases
fixture.status_bar_loading_confound: the after run's first focused sample started while the status bar still showed its Loading refresh spinner (own 30 fps lease); both settled samples were taken after the static refresh icon was verified in a screenshot
fixture.chat_orb: surface.chat.open fixture=true + surface.chat.send text=thought against Scripts/perf/acp-fixture.cmd; orb-idle-* samples sit at the fixture's go-gate (orb turning, no chunks), orb-stream-* during the 1500-chunk stream

verdict.render_counts: Titlebar.render and StatusBar.render fall from the root rate to 0 in every scenario (StatusBar 0.100/s in the after run's first focused sample: its own two state changes).
verdict.presentation_rate: unchanged: the root still renders on every spinner frame because the running row is its descendant; 30.6->30.3/s background first samples, 34.6->30.7/s settled background, 35.1->30.5/s settled focused (the 30-35/s spread is lease coalescing between runs, seen in both directions).
verdict.cpu: no measurable change: settled focused 3.893->4.674 %, settled background 3.600->3.945 %, first background 4.017->4.180 %, done-background 0.625/0.469->0.425 %; the eliminated render spans total about 0.26 % of one core (0.02 % of the machine), below the run-to-run spread of the 20 s windows.
verdict.decision: reverted from the PR under the rule that a fix whose measured number does not move is not shipped; the two-line change, its counters and its red/green test are preserved on branch perf/cached-shell-bars for a later decision.
